newsitem.title: CHINA: Three mutual funds to list on Shanghai bourse.
newsitem.headline: Three mutual funds to list on Shanghai bourse.

text.p: Three closed-ended mutual funds will be listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange on Friday, the Shanghai Securities newspaper said on Tuesday, the first time in three years that mutual funds have been listed on the exchange.

The funds, named Jinglong, Baoding and Jianye respectively, are 10-year closed-ended funds with 100 million shares each which were sold at the end of 1993 at a price of 1.04 yuan per share to teachers in Shanghai, it said.
The funds are managed by local state banks, it added but gave no more details.
The securities authorities have recently indicated in a number of ways that they plan to give renewed support to mutual funds as a way of channeling investment.
The Shanghai exchange currently has only one listed mutual fund, but 11 others registered elsewhere are also traded through the exchange's system.
